description: Use when you need a news briefing, a research summary of recent coverage or an analysis of what the press says about a topic or company. Do not use for breaking news, paywalled pages or one known article (use blackwood_webpage_markdown). Returns JSON with a research briefing on a topic in one call: up to 3 recent GDELT news articles, each read and summarized, with source and link, below the price of separate calls for 0.04 USDC per call. Typical response time 15000 ms (p95). Category: Search. Price: US$0.04 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

hours.description: How far back to look for news, in hours, 1 to 72 (24 when omitted), e.g. 48

language.description: Language of the summaries (English when omitted), e.g. Portuguese

topic.description: Topic, company or person to research, e.g. stablecoin regulation

name: blackwood_news_briefing
title: News research briefing
